title: Resource Manager: the API every door goes through

videos.script: Every way into Azure ends at the same address. The portal, the command line, Bicep and Terraform are all clients of one API. {{doors}} That API is Azure Resource Manager, at management dot azure dot com. {{arm}} A request travels in four steps. First, the client gets a token from Entra ID. {{token}} You will ask Entra ID for one with a tenant that does not exist, and read its refusal. {{refusal}} Second, the request goes to Resource Manager, with the token and an API version. {{request}} Third, Resource Manager decides. Is the caller allowed? Does a policy forbid it? Is the subscription sending too much? {{checks}} Fourth, it hands the request to the service that owns the type. {{provider}} In Resource Manager's API, a resource is a URL, and creating it is a PUT. You will turn a compiled template into those requests yourself. {{put}} And you will meet the other plane: the address where you use a resource, rather than manage it. {{end}}
